name: career-ops-dashboard-redesign
goal: Complete redesign of the JobTrackr dashboard for correct job-application tracking, integrated with the career-ops workflow (8 canonical statuses from templates/states.yml, live data from data/*.md files via server/api.mjs).

designDirection.concept: Mission Control — refined dark cockpit for a CODE RED job-search campaign
designDirection.base: deep space-blue (#0a0e17 family) with glass panels, high data density, clear hierarchy
designDirection.accent: electric indigo (#6366f1) → cyan (#06b6d4) gradient accents; JetBrains Mono for data/numbers
opinionatedTouches: CODE RED status ribbon in header (urgency signal)
Mono numerals everywhere data is displayed
Status-colored left border on table rows
Live/API offline indicator as a prominent pill

constraints.stack: React 19 + Vite + Tailwind 4 + Recharts + lucide-react + express API (server/api.mjs)
constraints.statusSource: templates/states.yml — 8 canonical statuses, dashboard MUST use exactly these

nodes.purpose: JobTrackr application shell: sidebar + header + tabbed content + detail modal
nodes.verification: tsc --noEmit clean; visual QA full page
nodes.notes: Tab ids: overview | pipeline | applications | burn-list | generate | settings

nodes.purpose: DESIGN_SYSTEM subgraph: tokens (colors, type, spacing, radius, shadow, motion), primitives (cards, badges, buttons, pills), status color semantics
nodes.notes: Tailwind 4 @theme in index.css. Keep bg-primary #0a0e17 family; indigo/cyan accents.

nodes.purpose: @theme tokens: colors, fonts (Inter + JetBrains Mono), animations (fade-in, slide-in, pulse)
nodes.verification: dev server renders without CSS errors
nodes.notes: Reuse existing token names (bg-primary, text-primary, gain/loss/warn/info/accent/cyan) so components keep working; ADD violet + status-specific tokens.

nodes.purpose: Semantic color mapping for the 8 canonical statuses (Evaluated/Applied/Responded/Interview/Offer/Rejected/Discarded/SKIP)
nodes.verification: each status has distinct readable badge
nodes.notes: MUST match states.yml exactly — no invented statuses.

nodes.purpose: Global chrome: Sidebar (nav + filters) + Header (title, tabs, search, CODE RED ribbon, LIVE/DEMO pill, new-application button)
nodes.notes: Header is the pilot module — QA it BEFORE scaling to other modules.

nodes.purpose: Top header: tab nav, search, CODE RED ribbon, API status pill, new application button, metric chips
nodes.notes: PILOT. Fix HeaderProps mismatch in App.tsx (apiConnected not in props today).

nodes.purpose: Left nav: tabs, view filters (showRejected/showDiscarded/showSkipped), sortBy, viewMode, autoRefresh, compactMode
nodes.verification: visual QA; config toggles persist in state
nodes.notes: Fix showWithdrawn vs showDiscarded mismatch in SidebarConfig.

nodes.purpose: Wire header + sidebar + App state (activeTab, search, config) — verify before sections
API client + mock fallback: fetchApplications, fetchBurnList, fetchSession, fetchStats, fetchReports, checkApiHealth, fetchPipeline, fetchScanHistory, fetchOutputFiles, fetchProfile + mockData
nodes.verification: tsc clean; app renders with API up AND with mock fallback
nodes.notes: MISSING FILES — root cause of broken build. Rebuild per types/index.ts. RawApplication type needed.

nodes.purpose: Overview tab: metric cards row, charts (weekly trend, response donut, status bar), profile card, action bar, activity feed, burn list preview
nodes.notes: Metrics MUST come from live data via /api/stats + parsed applications, not hardcoded.

nodes.purpose: 6 metric cards: Total, Active, Applied, Interviews, Offers, Avg Score — mono numerals, sparkline support
WeeklyTrendChart (recharts), ResponseDonut, StatusBarChart — dark theme charts
nodes.verification: charts render with real data; visual QA

nodes.purpose: ProfileCard: name, location, visa, hours, german level + target, target roles — from session/profile API
ActivityFeed: applied/interview/offer/rejected/update/reminder/scan/sync activity types
nodes.verification: all 8 activity types render; visual QA
nodes.notes: Fix missing scan/sync in icon map.

nodes.purpose: Burn list preview card (top 3 companies) + link to burn-list tab
Verify overview subtree: metrics from live data, charts render, profile populated, activity feed complete
Pipeline tab: kanban-style flow of applications through the 8 career-ops stages
Kanban columns per status group, cards with company/role/score, click → detail modal
nodes.verification: visual QA; card click opens ApplicationDetail

nodes.purpose: Verify pipeline subtree renders all status groups and interactions
Applications tab: sortable/filterable table + detail modal with status edit
Table: #, date, company, role, score, status badge, pdf/report links, notes — search + sort + status-colored row accent
Modal: full application details, score, status change via PUT /api/applications/:id, pdf/report links, job URL
Verify table + detail + status edit flow end-to-end
nodes.verification: visual QA; PUT works against real file

nodes.purpose: Burn List tab: companies with rejection cooldown
List of burned companies: company, role, rejection date, reason, earliest reapply
Verify burn list subtree
Generate tab: CV generation panel, cover letter panel, output files list
GenerateCVPanel: company/role/lang form → POST /api/generate-cv, show results (html/pdf links)
CoverLetterPanel: company/role/jobUrl/snippet/motivation → POST /api/generate-cover-letter
OutputFileList: GET /api/output-files → downloadable pdf/html/md list
Verify generate tab: tabs work, forms submit, files list
FINAL: cross-section composition, responsive, a11y, performance, interaction consistency, full-page visual QA
nodes.verification: tsc clean; build succeeds; full-page visual QA; responsive check
nodes.notes: Gate: all child integrations verified before this completes.
